acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

dense_fitting_model.final_admission: Original full-resolution raw bilinear final statistics, count/fraction/depth/error gates; no filtered final admission
dense_fitting_model.fitting_point: Separate source XYZ: ((x-cx)*z*(1/fx)), ((y-cy)*z*(1/fy)), z each cast f32 then promoted f64; proper pose transform in f64. Skip a fitting row if this transformed point is not finite with positive z.
dense_fitting_model.gradients: Sobel separable horizontal [-1,0,1],vertical [1,2,1] for x and swapped for y; f32 operator output promoted f64 then multiplied by 1/8. Each nonfinite depth derivative becomes zero. Local surrogate, not an exact derivative of rounded lookup.
dense_fitting_model.initial_filter: Gaussian3 weights [0.25,0.5,0.25] on gray and depth using the separable operator; NaNs propagate
dense_fitting_model.input: u8 gray divided by 255 in f32; metric f32 depth promoted to f64; original inclusive finite depth admission and NaN holes
dense_fitting_model.iterations: All original 20,10,5 scheduled updates; no epsilon early exit
dense_fitting_model.matching: Retain native f64 source unproject ((x-cx)*z/fx,(y-cy)*z/fy,z), proper pose transform and projection. trunc(projected+0.5), finite signed bounds before usize, finite selected target depth and original metric difference gate. No target uniqueness or bitwise external correspondence equivalence claim.
dense_fitting_model.normal_equations: Existing residual_jacobians, f64; multiply each J and residual by sqrt(1-depth_weight) or sqrt(depth_weight), then accumulate in f64 with unit weight in existing fixed 16-row tile order. No unchecked external solver behavior.
dense_fitting_model.normalization: Once, initial rounded correspondences in row-major order; f64 means/gains, gain=0.5/mean; require minimum count and finite positive means/gains before mutation; each multiplied gray value stored as f32 without clipping
dense_fitting_model.ownership: Safe borrowed Rust input; Python owns four image copies before GIL release; CPU only, explicit device transfers unchanged
dense_fitting_model.pose_update: Proper left Rz(delta_z)*Ry(delta_y)*Rx(delta_x), t_new=R_step*t_old+delta_translation; finite proper AbsolutePose admission
dense_fitting_model.preprocessing_selector: raw only; reject every other preprocessing combination
dense_fitting_model.pyramid: Floor width/2,height/2, each scheduled level >=3x3; gray separable Gaussian3 then left-associated f32 (a+b+c+d)/4; depth same f32 mean without Gaussian; nonfinite propagates; halve fx,fy,cx,cy
dense_fitting_model.residuals: Photometric target-source subtraction in f32 promoted f64. Depth target f32 promoted f64 minus transformed quantized point.z in f64.
dense_fitting_model.separable_operator: Replicate edges. Each horizontal tap product is f32; accumulate the three products in order in f64 and store f32. Each vertical product is f32; accumulate in order in f64 and store f32. Recompute horizontal samples locally to avoid an additional full-plane intermediate. All taps participate, including zero times NaN.
dense_fitting_model.solve: Existing finite-checked pivoted f64 Gaussian solver; singular/nonfinite failure remains failure
dense_fitting_model.storage: Owned f64 Level buffers explicitly holding f32-quantized fitting values; no f32 memory-saving claim
dense_fitting_model.workers: At most four private CPU workers, deterministic ordered tiles; WASM serial
dense_fitting_model.working_bytes: 32*sum(floor-pyramid pixels)+64*base_pixels+max(ceil(height/16)*sizeof(Normal),48*sizeof(f64)); checked arithmetic/options before allocation; excludes caller/Python inputs, allocator metadata and stacks

dense_support_policy: Minimum count and a nonsingular system for initial/intermediate hypotheses; the unchanged 0.5 full-resolution correspondence fraction applies to the returned pose. The independent full-cloud support and complete trajectory accuracy gates are unchanged.
generation: All four are already observed development recordings. Reuse existing prepared PNG/index hard links without payload copies/downloads. Preserve every original source/calibration/control/accuracy gate and all old failures; explicitly replace only the complete fitting model. Freeze all four full timelines before any score. Identity first, preceding returned increment subsequently; full cloud/world/IO/causal audits; no reference in generation, retry, reset, trim, post-score model adjustment or held-out qualification claim.
native_refinement_policy: Fixed complete reference-precision model; original raw final admission and every original accuracy gate. All four full timelines frozen before scoring; observed development data only.
scope: 146S independent source models reproduce all six separate native/reference one-step outputs. This motivates a complete opt-in arithmetic/retraction model; it does not establish the cause of a real trajectory error.
